headline: Rakesh Kumar Rawat Submits SEBI Takeover Disclosure for Prozone Realty Limited
sum: Rakesh Kumar Rawat has filed a disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4) regarding substantial acquisition of shares in Prozone Realty Limited. The filing was submitted to the NSE in compliance with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
detail: Rakesh Kumar Rawat has submitted a mandatory disclosure to the NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Code. This regulation requires acquirers to disclose to the stock exchange and the company when they have crossed or are about to cross specified thresholds of substantial shareholding. The filing does not specify the exact shareholding percentage, acquisition value, or timeline for a potential open offer, which would typically be detailed in the full disclosure document filed with SEBI.
